description: CRITICAL Authentication Security Fixes - Fix authentication bypass vulnerabilities in save_consolidated_clocking.php and other endpoints where auth failures allow continued processing. Ensure all endpoints fail closed and implement proper IP header validation.
steps: Fix save_consolidated_clocking.php authentication logic to fail closed - remove the system issue fallback path that allows processing without auth when requireAuth() throws non-critical exceptions
Fix upload_clocking_evidence_images.php to prevent client-supplied filename path traversal by using server-generated filenames exclusively
Add IP header validation to security_middleware.php - only trust X-Forwarded-For headers from configured reverse proxies
Review and standardize authentication patterns across all mobile/*.php endpoints to ensure consistent fail-closed behavior
Add file access controls to manual_clocking_evidence directories - ensure learner photos/signatures cannot be accessed via direct URLs
acceptance_criteria: save_consolidated_clocking.php never processes clocking records when authentication fails - all auth exceptions result in 401 responses
upload_clocking_evidence_images.php generates all filenames server-side preventing directory traversal attacks
IP headers are only trusted from whitelisted proxy sources defined in configuration
All PHP endpoints follow consistent authentication pattern with no bypass paths
Evidence files return 403/404 when accessed directly without authenticated API calls
verification: Test authentication bypass by sending requests without Bearer tokens - verify 401 responses
Test path traversal by sending malicious filenames - verify server-generated names only
Test direct file access to evidence directories - verify blocked access
Review all mobile/*.php files for consistent auth patterns
